name: -6AN Flare to 3/8" Quick Connect Adapter
title: -6AN Flare to 3/8" Quick Connect Adapter
description:
-6AN Male Flare to 3/8" Male Quick Disconnect Fuel Adapter

Allows for seamless conversion of OEM-Style female quick-connect fittings to AN lines in Fuel and Vacuum systems.

Technical Specifications:

 	-6AN male flare (37* JIC)
 	3/8"(9.53mm) male quick connect
 	E85 & Racefuel compatible
 	Signature polished, black anodized finish
